- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The discovery of milk is believed to have happened accidentally by early humans around 10,000 years ago when they domesticated animals like cows, goats, and sheep.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Early humans may have discovered milk by observing young animals nursing and eventually attempted to milk these animals themselves.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Historically, milk has been an important source of nutrition for many cultures, consumed raw, boiled, or fermented into products like cheese and yogurt.
